item.title: Darrow, The Reaper, in Pegasus Armor: A Red Rising Gift for Your Favourite Howler
item.description: For the Howler in your life. This is Darrow, the Reaper, in his Pegasus armor, a decorative figure meant to sit on a bookshelf, a desk or in a display cabinet beside their Red Rising books. We make each one to order in our small shop in Canada, printed in PLA. A good gift for the friend who has already read the series twice.
